notes.title: Where’s the Update?!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Be Chill — It’s Coming! Not sooner, but it will[/b][/h2]

We get it. You’re wondering, “Where’s the update?!”
Hey, we’re working on it! Game dev isn't instant noodles — it takes time, love, and a whole lot of debugging rage.

To show you we haven’t vanished into the void, here’s a little concept tease to keep the hype alive:

[previewyoutube=gGLDxrBpl4E;full][/previewyoutube]
Some of you maniacs already blasted through to loop 10 (seriously?!). Keep it up — replay, experiment, break the game (gently), and most importantly: tell your friends about it.

Want to support us? Snag those DLCs. It helps more than you know.

We’re still here, still building, and yes — still fueled by caffeine and your support. So don’t ghost us! Stick around. More cool stuff is on the way.

notes.title: 🚀 Unleashing the Long Hair Style Update!
notes.notes:
At the end of February, we teased a brand-new hair DLC—now it's finally here! Get ready to style up your favorite characters and dive into fresh gameplay mechanics in this jam-packed update!

[h2]✨ Long Hair Sisters Have Arrived![/h2]
[previewyoutube=8cHcoA2QzoU;full][/previewyoutube]

The adorable [b]Long Hair Sisters DLC[/b] is here! Featuring [b]two stunning long hairstyles[/b], this DLC lets you customize your characters for ultimate cuteness.

💲 Available now for only [b]$3.99[/b]—and don’t miss out on the [b]first-release discount![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543280/Banzai_Escape_2_Subterranean__Long_Hairs/

Every purchase [b]directly supports future game development[/b], so grab your copy and help us bring even more awesome content to life!

[h2]⚔️ New Melee Combo System![/h2]
[previewyoutube=y6zJjIyk1Bk;full][/previewyoutube]

We've reworked the melee system to bring [b]fast-paced combo attacks[/b]! Now, you can chain melee hits together for a [b]smoother and deadlier combat experience[/b].

[b]💡 Pro Tip:[/b] Use [b]Blast Immunity / Kinetics Absorber Nanoplugin[/b] to immune yourself from enemies melee.
[u](Note: Melee weapons aren’t available just yet—stay tuned for their arrival in the [b]final mission area[/b]!)[/u]

[h2]🔫 Enhanced Camera Recoil![/h2]
[previewyoutube=nGMaYuLr8Io;full][/previewyoutube]

To make gunfights feel even more immersive, we’ve introduced [b]dynamic camera recoil[/b] when firing weapons.

🔥 Guns now feel [b]more intense[/b], with added feedback for a realistic shooting experience.
[b]💡 Pro Tip:[/b] Use high-stability weapons for better recoil control!

[h2]🌍 New Language Support![/h2]
We’re thrilled to introduce [b]Vietnamese[/b] as a new in-game language, thanks to our amazing community! Additionally, we've updated translations for [b]Traditional Chinese and Russian[/b].

More languages = [b]more players enjoying the game worldwide![/b] 🌏

[h2]🛠️ [b]Patch 46 Notes[/b][/h2]
[h3]✔ New Features & Mechanics:[/h3]
[list]  
[*]Added [b]camera recoil shake[/b] during gunfire.[/*]  
[*]Introduced a [b]new melee combo system[/b].[/*][/list][h3]🌎 Language Updates:[/h3]
[list]  
[*]Added [b]Vietnamese[/b] (Community translation).[/*]

[list] 
[*]Removed [b]player disintegration effect[/b].[/*]  
[*]Increased [b]NanoSys healing requirements[/b] for higher loop levels.[/*]  
[*]Rolling [b]no longer requires movement input[/b].[/*]  
[*][b]Fire damage now stacks[/b] over time if NPCs remain in flames.[/*]  
[*][b]Fixed[/b] color preset error after restarting the game.[/*]  
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Jena’s flamethrower effect.[/*]  
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Cpt. Hans' movement bug during special attacks.[/*]  
[*][b]Fixed[/b] missing screen effects after resolution changes.[/*][/list]
[h2]🛠️ [b]Hotfix 46.1 Notes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed npc sticking to player
[*] Fixed wrong input of nano number requirement for healing
[*] Fixed now nano amount appear correctly when to heal / revive

[h2]🔥 More Updates Coming Soon![/h2]
Your support keeps us going, and we have [b]even bigger updates on the way[/b]! Stay sharp, and we’ll see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Halloween Update! Spooky one
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/091b500b98c2ba10a2c95cd6890fdd9decebf750.png[/img]
[b]Hotfix : Fixed can't enter random generated level[/b]

Greetings, Sisters!

To celebrate Spooky month,
Get ready to dive back into action with two brand-new levels in Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean and other new awesome goodies which we included in this update. Here’s what you can expect:

[h1]New Levels : Prison Break and Train Sabotage![/h1]

[h2][b]Prison Break[/b][/h2]
In this mission, you’ll be breaking in of a fully guarded prison, fighting off waves of Lanun, and rescuing your fellow captured sisters. As you make your way through the complex, fight through the prison guard and unlock prison cells, be prepare for fierce battles with mobs of Lanun determined to stop you at all costs. The prison is filled with danger at every turn, and you’ll need to explore its multi-level structure to ensure no sister is left behind. Stay sharp, stay strong, and show the Lanun what the sisters are capable of!

This level is to fulfill the missing [b]EASY DIFFICULTY MISSION[/b] . Please take it easy and use a low dmg weapon to get best experience of playing it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/473c7f7d76749334550942758d6441419eaa1a4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/9ddc51451b43e0e670e67491e6456bcb82cca279.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/56c3b0feb1268df07000c1f050583951a5c71986.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/b9671a09c615cdd8d0418a3ef2d7796b5bfdb017.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/aae76accec02b7310f2d22b91fc76c408bc10fe1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Train Sabotage[/b][/h2]
Lanun have been known for running a raw nano crystal dealer, and it’s up to you to wreck havoc on their delivery operation. Board a fast-moving train, disrupt their activity, and prevent the crystals from reaching their destination. Explore dimly lit compartments, strategize your approach, and take down enemies guarding their precious cargo and fight off their armored train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/4afea841b4349b905896708bdd2dd96ddd6e0e57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/470a203aa2c840684a2a9551eb6b507d3acf3247.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/8bdf5468f1ff248e93e85a9e3d47a9e2a296e95b.png[/img]

Each level brings unique challenges and environments, designed to test your combat skills. We can’t wait to see how you tackle these new missions. 

[h2]Attention : Levels might have bugs in co-op mode. Play within your own risk[/h2]

...And It doesn’t end here, we would like to introduce the new cosmetics that fulfill your needs. This to ensure you guys can customize your sister with new DLC and halloween theme costumes

[h2]Check it out~[/h2]

[h2]New DLC Costume:[/h2]
[h1]Sister School Uniform Set![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304600/Banzai_Escape_2_Subterranean__Sister_School_Uniform/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/2f91e7d0e82b812fc1e26de3cb1989bc14c1bde5.jpg[/img]
This highly customizable outfit brings the iconic schoolgirl look with a tactical twist, allowing players to mix and match pieces for the perfect in-game style. The set includes four unique tops, three types of skirts, two pairs of shoes, a stylish bag, and even a uniform jacket to complete the look.

Choose between a long sleeve or short sleeve school uniform with or without a sweater vest, giving you plenty of ways to express your character's personality. For the skirts, pick from the traditional long skirt, a shorter version for a trendy vibe, or the short skirt with knee pads and baggy socks for that combat-ready flair. Footwear options include classic school indoor shoes or elegant loafers, perfect for switching between casual and formal styles.

To complete the look, the set includes a leather school bag and a uniform jacket, perfect for bringing both style and functionality to your missions. With so many ways to customize, this set is perfect for personalizing your character’s aesthetic in Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/2ecf395fbd7a82560d44b7fadd8aaf42c7d478a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/db5871b6cbdcdf1eb3ad3841ee1447d65e14031c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/d04b83abb22a1e222a3ad011412861c8e9328adc.jpg[/img]

[h2]New DLC Hair: [/h2]
[h1]Kewl Hair Bundle[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225580/Banzai_Escape_2_Subterranean__Kewl_Hairs/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/0dc012c08339d9e0ed64c27788a8daa8ea87fb23.jpg[/img]
The Kewl Hair Bundle DLC introduces two new stylish hairstyles for even more customization! The Oneesan style offers a sleek, short cut that exudes a mature, confident vibe, perfect for players who want their character to give off that cool, composed big sister energy. Meanwhile, the Hime Ponytail combines the elegance of the traditional hime cut with a youthful ponytail, making it an ideal choice for a fresh, energetic look. Whether you’re going for refined or spirited, these hairstyles will enhance your character’s personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/33ace38d75cfd3bf4a8653dfecf14135f36ad059.jpg[/img]

[h1]now FREE STUFF Goodies below[/h1]

[h2]New Free Hairstyle[/h2]
For those who love a more laid-back look, we've added a new short tomboy-ish hairstyle which is free. It features a sharp, clean cut with a side-swept fringe and an ahoge for a playful touch. This hairstyle is perfect for characters with a confident, no-nonsense vibe, while still maintaining a bit of charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/d8f92d1fa7d172d0a2bc9a270c6b7f046caa038d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Witch Coat and Witch Hat[/h2]
Celebrate the spooky season with the newly added Witch Coat and Witch Hat! This free costume features a dramatic long coat with burnt edges and a wide-brimmed witch hat, giving your character a mysterious and magical appearance. Get ready to embrace the dark and mystical for your next adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/536b9688f42dc4363c003e05f44a928a20969e3b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/9b20fa97e53a4f7f2baba36bb1a6995a4ad43973.jpg[/img]

[h2]Kitty Pumpkin Hat and Pumpkin Mask[/h2]
Bring some fun into October with the Kitty Pumpkin Hat and Pumpkin Mask costume. This playful ensemble features a giant pumpkin head with adorable cat ears, putting a cute twist on the traditional Halloween pumpkin. Add some spooky fun to your game and stand out in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/8657feee0cb69fed6f994139b15295beb245c6f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/2113994a6ff161469e668ee7647b804109be558e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Free Hats and Eyewear[/h2]
We’re also adding a variety of quirky and fun free headgear and eyewear for free! Choose from the Mini Hat, Deer Headband, Helmet Kapcai, Smiley Mask, Love Sunglasses, Flamingo Glasses, and even a Tiny Mustache. Perfect for adding a bit of humor and personality to your character.

notes.title: Merdeka Update Alert: Unleash Chaos!
notes.notes:
Hello players!

Get ready to dive into a whole new level of action and excitement as Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean rolls out 
its most thrilling update yet! 
Prepare to experience the game like never before with the introduction of Nano-Plugins, a fiery addition to enemy reactions, and some sizzling costumes.

[h1]Nano-Plugins: Call Reinforcements and Unleash Napalm Fury[/h1]

The Nano-Plugins are here to revolutionize your combat strategy! 
These cutting-edge plugins will empower you in ways you've never imagined:

[h2][b]1. Call Reinforcements: [/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/174c918b4d69b1a9a24e67a7e219479c72602923.png[/img]
Feel the adrenaline surge as you can now summon backup sisters fighters to join 
you in the heat of battle. Team up, strategize, and dominate the enemy like never before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/0226d82f175005c68c6e2df3d122fb8dc4a1439f.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Reactions: Enemies Feel the Heat and Get Stunned[/h1]
The enemies in Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean are no longer rush without fears. 
They've become smarter, more reactive, and fiercer than ever:

[h2][b]1. React to Fire and Burning: [/b][/h2]
Ignite your enemies and witness their frantic reactions as 
they desperately attempt to extinguish the flames. It's not just about firepower anymore;

Expect enhanced style, durability, and combat prowess as you don these sleek and empowering ensembles.

notes.title: Patch 29 and Progression!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! Everynyan~!

We hope you're doing well and we appreciate your continued support. Thanks to all of you, we've come a long way!

Today, we're excited to announce the release of "PATCH 29," our latest update. Here's what it includes:

[h1]Highlight of the news[/h1]
[h2]Enhanced Water Effects: [/h2]
We've implemented captivating water effects, including splashes and new water visuals in select levels. 
This minor cosmetic update adds more life to the game. Check out the pictures below!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/506e192fb23cd7dcb3f8df2117653d4b4abf28d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improved Waypoint System: [/h2]
We've modified the system to guide you directly towards your objectives, ensuring a better navigation experience. 
See the pictures for a clearer understanding.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/dfc798da69995156c8f9cb6bbc5a59426deaa0e7.png[/img]

[h2]Chinese Cantonese Language: [/h2]
We've added support for Cantonese, so our Chinese players can enjoy the game in their preferred language. 
A big thanks to our language provider, Fuyltare Mahx!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/fed5f857adb5428e0c51f9774ee7eaecccebe25d.png[/img]

Point Info "PATCH 29":

[*] Added water effects, splashed, and also new water on some level
[*] Fixed minor AI navigations towards stationary turrets
[*] Modified to make companion turrets changed color to RED if its hostiles or broken
[*] Modified making waypoints will pointing toward objectives position instead center of mission level
[/list]

In addition to the patch, we have some exciting news to share about our upcoming mission pack, which we've temporarily named 
[h2]"OPERATION HIGHWAY DOWN." [/h2]
This new pack takes place in subterranean highway lanes and introduces new adversaries like the SPECTRE soldiers and quite possibly the Rogue sisters will be roaming around too.
